videos.script: Somebody registers, and agenda sends them an e-mail. The obvious place is the view, right after the save. {{title}} Then the mail server goes down. The registration is saved, and the answer is a 500. The person tries again, and hears they are already registered. {{inline}} So the mail leaves the request. Redis holds the message, and a Celery worker sends it. The request answers 201 and moves on. {{queue}} A task that fails, though, is simply gone. So it retries, with growing pauses, until the mail server is back. {{retry}} And a task that retries must be safe to run twice. The row records that the mail went out, and a second run stops there. {{twice}} Then Redis goes down, and the 500 comes back. The queue took the mail server out of the request and put Redis in it. One argument contains it. {{redis}} A sweep, run every minute by beat, finds what was missed and sends it. {{beat}} Last, FastAPI's background tasks. They are simpler, they run after the response, and they forget everything when they fail.
